dupesCleanAll.description: Top row of the palette's duplicate-cleanup mode; removes every redundant copy in one go.

extDesc.message: A popup bookmark manager. Enhanced Neat Bookmarks. Neater than Neater Bookmarks.

folderEmpty.description: Row shown inside an expanded folder that has no children.

noTitle.description: The title for untitled bookmarks with no http(s) URL or untitled folders.

openBookmarksNewWindow.message: Open All Bookmarks in New Window

bookmarkOpenInExistingGroup.description: Bookmark context-menu item: lets the user pick an existing browser tab group, then opens the bookmark into it.

openSidePanelCommand.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut command that opens the side panel.

optionAnnounceEnabledHint.message: Release notes and tips from the project's GitHub repository (fetched at most every 6 hours). Off also stops the network fetch.

optionOpenInSidePanel.message: Open in side panel instead of popup

optionPopupStays.message: Popup stays open when opening (left-clicking) bookmarks.

optionRememberPrevState.message: Remember previous state (scroll position, opened folders and the last focused item).

optionsFooterText.description: Footer text for the Options page

paletteClose.description: Command palette: label of the visible footer button that closes the panel (the keyboard path is Esc).

paletteCmdDupes.description: Command palette entry that switches the panel into duplicate-bookmark cleanup mode (slash command /dupes).

paletteCmdNewFolder.description: Command palette entry that creates a folder at the bottom of the quick-add folder.

palettePlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the command palette input field.

parentFolder.description: Parent folder in formation displayed in the tooltip of bookmarks in search results list.

reportedToDeveloper.description: A message for an error occured in the extension, has been reported to the developer.
reportedToDeveloper.message: This has been reported to the developer.

searchNoResults.description: Shown in the popup when a search returns no matching bookmarks.

searchViewHint.message: Type in the box above to search your bookmarks

selectAll.description: Selection mode (dead/dupes views): select every row/group.

selectClear.description: Selection mode (dead/dupes views): clear the whole selection.

selectCount.description: Selection mode (dead/dupes views): label with the current selection size.

selectModeExit.description: Selection mode (dead/dupes views): leave the mode.

sessionEmpty.description: Alert shown when the current window has no tabs that can be bookmarked.

optionQuickAddContextMenuHint.message: Independent from the quick-add star button; the classic-experience restore also turns this entry off.

optionCollapseTabGroupMenu.message: Collapse the tab-group entries into one "Tab groups" submenu

optionCollapseTabGroupMenuHint.message: Applies to both the folder and bookmark right-click menus. Off by default; keeps low-height menus shorter on small/high-zoom screens.

optionCollapseSortMenu.message: Collapse the sort entries into one "Sort" submenu
optionCollapseSortMenu.description: Options checkbox (issue #48 follow-up): folds the three sort items of the folder context menu into a single submenu entry.

optionCollapseSortMenuHint.message: Applies to the folder right-click menu. On by default.

optionShowToolButton.message: Show the tool button (⋮) next to the search box

optionShowItemPath.message: Show the parent folder path on list rows

sortByName.description: Folder context-menu item (issue #33): sort the folder's contents by title, with the persisted folders-first/recursive options.

sortByDate.description: Folder context-menu item (issue #33): sort by date added (newest first), with the persisted folders-first/recursive options.

sortOptions.description: Folder context-menu item (issue #33): opens the sort dialog for one-off options.

sortDone.description: Toast shown after sorting a folder's contents; the Undo button restores the previous order.

sortRecursiveWarning.message: This reorders bookmarks in every subfolder.

deadFilterAll.description: Dead-link view filter segment: show the whole result set.

deadFilterBlocked.description: Dead-link view filter segment: show only rows unreachable directly but reachable through the proxy.

deadFilterDead.description: Dead-link view filter segment: show only rows dead on every channel.

deadFilterMarked.description: Dead-link view filter segment: show only the user's manually marked bookmarks from before (the marked-only view, results hidden).

deadLastScanAt.description: Info row on top of the dead-link view when cached scan results exist; $time$ is the localized scan timestamp.

deadMark.description: Row button / context menu item that marks a bookmark as dead (red × overlay everywhere).

deadMarkAll.description: Batch button in the dead-link view: mark every dead/blocked row of the current result set.

deadMarked.description: Toast shown after the "mark all" batch action finished.

deadMarkedCount.description: Dead view: count of user-marked bookmarks shown when no scan result list is on screen (a cancelled scan keeps the marks).

deadMarkedNone.description: Empty state of the past-marks (上次标注) category when the last scan left no marks; a scan has run, so this is a plain empty state, not the first-run start button.

deadMarkedRow.description: Dead view: per-row badge on a user-marked bookmark in the standalone marked-rows list (shown when no scan result row hosts the mark).

deadMarkSelected.description: Dead view selection mode: mark every selected row as dead.

deadMarkStatusAll.description: Dead view second toolbar (mark-status filter): show rows regardless of their mark status (distinct wording from the category toolbar's All).

deadMarkStatusMarked.description: Dead view second toolbar (mark-status filter): show only rows carrying the user's dead mark.

deadMarkStatusUnmarked.description: Dead view second toolbar (mark-status filter): show only rows without the user's dead mark.

deadMarkTimeLabel.description: Dead view row tooltip label: the absolute time a row was marked dead (appended to the tooltip, and to the second line of the wide/panel layout).

deadDetectTimeLabel.description: Dead view row tooltip label: the absolute time a row's scan check returned its dead/blocked verdict (appended to the tooltip, and to the second line of the wide/panel layout).

deadSortLabel.description: Dead view sort dropdown: aria-label of the trigger and the listbox.

deadSortByDetected.description: Dead view sort dropdown option: order rows by when the scan checked them.

deadSortByPath.description: Dead view sort dropdown option: order rows by their folder path.

deadSortByMarked.description: Dead view sort dropdown option: order rows by when they were marked dead.

deadMarkedBanner.message: Showing bookmarks marked previously. Click Rescan to start a new check, or handle them in the list below.
deadMarkedBanner.description: Dead view tooltip banner above the toolbar when the previously-marked list is on screen (marked-only view after a cancelled scan / the 'Previously marked' filter, or the appended list under 全部 when a finished scan left marks that are now reachable): points to the rescan action and the handleable list below.

deadMarkedBannerDismiss.description: Dead view marked-list tooltip banner: aria-label/title of the × that hides the hint for the session.

deadProxyAdd.message: Add a proxy server for dead-link checks

deadProxyLabel.description: Dead view proxy strip chip showing the configured proxy server; $server$ is scheme://host:port.

deadProxyChange.description: Dead view proxy strip: reopen the add panel prefilled with the configured proxy server.

deadProxyRemove.description: Dead view proxy strip: remove the configured proxy server.

deadProxyRemoved.description: Toast after the dead view's proxy server was removed.

deadProxyPanelHint.message: Enter a proxy server you already have (the extension provides none), e.g. 127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080.
deadProxyPanelHint.description: Hint line of the dead view's inline add-proxy panel.

deadProxyTestUrlLabel.description: Label/tooltip of the reachability test URL field in the dead view's add-proxy panel.

deadProxyTesting.description: Busy state of the dead view's add-proxy panel while the reachability probe runs.

deadProxySaved.message: Proxy saved — future scans re-check direct failures through it
deadProxySaved.description: Toast after a reachable proxy server was saved in the dead view.

deadProxyInvalid.description: Error of the dead view's add-proxy panel when the address does not parse.

deadProxyUnreachable.description: Error of the dead view's add-proxy panel when the reachability probe failed.

deadProxyDenied.description: Error when the user dismisses Chrome's proxy permission prompt (dead view add-proxy flow or scan gate).

deadProxyControlled.message: Proxy settings are managed by another extension
deadProxyControlled.description: Error when another extension controls Chrome's proxy settings (dead view add-proxy flow or scan gate).

deadProxyUnavailable.message: The proxy API is unavailable in this browser
deadProxyUnavailable.description: Error when chrome.proxy is missing (dead view add-proxy flow or scan gate).

deadProxyNudge.description: Dead view proxy strip nudge shown after a scan when no proxy is configured.

deadProxyNeverShow.description: Dead view proxy strip: hides the no-server add/nudge hint permanently; the proxy stays configurable from the options page.

deadStartHint.description: Executable empty state of the dead-link view before the first scan; $n$ is the scannable bookmark count.

deadStatusBlocked.description: Amber status pill of a blocked row (direct fetch failed, proxy channel reached the target).

deadUnmark.description: Row button / context menu item that removes the dead mark from a bookmark.

deadUnmarkAll.description: Batch button in the dead-link view: remove every dead mark.

deadUnmarkSelected.description: Dead view selection mode: remove the dead mark from every selected row.

dupesApplySelected.description: Dupes view selection mode: apply dedup to the selected groups; $count$ is the total doomed row count.

dupesCleanRestHint.description: Tooltip/aria-label of the quick action on a duplicate group header: apply the configured keeper strategy to this group alone — keep $title$, delete the other $count$ rows.

dupesIgnoreScheme.description: Duplicates view checkbox: treat http and https variants of an address as duplicates.

dupesKeepThis.description: aria-label of the keeper radio on a duplicate member row.

dupesKeeperSet.description: Context menu item on a duplicate member row: make it the keeper of its group.

dupesPreviewSummary.description: Summary text in the duplicates view toolbar; $groups$ duplicate groups, $count$ rows doomed by the current keeper choices.

dupesRemoveRow.description: aria-label of the delete button on a duplicate member row.

dupesScopeAll.description: Duplicates view scope selector: scan the whole bookmark tree.

dupesScopeBar.description: Duplicates view scope selector: scan only the bookmarks-bar subtree.

dupesStrategyBookmarkBar.message: Keep the one in the bookmarks bar

dupesStrategyMostVisited.description: Keeper strategy: keep the copy with the highest recorded visit count.

dupesStrategyNewest.description: Keeper strategy: keep the bookmark added most recently.

dupesStrategyOldest.description: Keeper strategy: keep the bookmark added earliest.

dupesStrategyShallowest.description: Keeper strategy: keep the copy closest to the root folder.

dupesStrategyShortestTitle.description: Keeper strategy: keep the copy with the shortest title.

optionDeadProxyServer.description: Options label for the user's own proxy server used by the dead-link scan's second channel.

deadProxyServerHint.description: Hint under the options page's dead-link proxy server row.

deadProxyClear.description: Button clearing the saved dead-link proxy server on the options page.

deadProxyNone.description: Placeholder shown when no dead-link proxy server is configured (options page).

optionDeadProxyStrip.message: Show the add-a-proxy hint in the dead-links view
optionDeadProxyStrip.description: Options checkbox controlling the dead view's no-server proxy hint strip (add button + nudge + dismiss ×).

optionDeadProxyStripHint.description: Hint under the options checkbox controlling the dead view's proxy hint strip.

optionDeadScanConcurrency.description: Advanced options label for the dead-link scan concurrency pool size.

optionDeadScanTimeout.description: Advanced options label for the per-request dead-link probe timeout.

paletteCmdGoSearch.description: Command palette entry (slash command /search) that switches to the search view.

paletteCmdGoTree.description: Command palette entry (slash command /tree) that switches to the bookmark tree view.

paletteCmdOptions.description: Command palette entry (slash command /options) that opens the extension options page.

rowActionReveal.description: aria-label of the row button that reveals the bookmark in the tree view.

viewDead.description: View tab title for the dead-link scan view.

viewDupes.description: View tab title for the duplicate-bookmark cleanup view.

viewStats.description: View tab title for the visit-statistics view.

paletteCmdGoStats.description: Command palette entry: switch to the visit-statistics view (slash alias /stats).

optionStatsEnabled.description: Options checkbox (Views group): master switch for visit-statistics collection.

optionFaviconContrastHint.message: White icons on light themes and black icons on dark themes are inverted so they stay visible. Each icon is sampled once when it loads — no cost while browsing.
optionFaviconContrastHint.description: Options hint under the favicon-contrast checkbox, explaining the low-overhead one-time-per-icon sampling.

optionFaviconEnrichHint.message: For bookmarked sites Chrome has no cached icon for, fetch the real icon directly from the site (/favicon.ico, then the page’s declared icons). Requests only go to sites you bookmarked.
optionFaviconEnrichHint.description: Hint under the favicon enrich checkbox.

optionFaviconEnrichAgg.description: Options checkbox (Views group): sub-switch enabling the built-in list of third-party icon services (favicon.run, then DuckDuckGo) as a last-resort fallback when direct fetching fails.

optionFaviconEnrichAggHint.message: When direct fetching fails, look the icon up by domain from a built-in list of third-party icon services (favicon.run, then DuckDuckGo). A service found unreachable is skipped and the next one is tried — it is not retried for 6 hours.
optionFaviconEnrichAggHint.description: Hint under the third-party icon fallback checkbox.

optionFaviconBackup.description: Options checkbox (Icons group): whether the settings export/import also carries the enriched favicon cache (per-site data, potentially large). Off by default to keep backups small.

optionFaviconBackupHint.message: Also pack the enriched favicon cache (per-site data, potentially large) into the settings export/import. This covers icons already cached even while fetching is off. Off keeps backups small; icons are re-fetched automatically anyway.

optionFaviconCacheClear.description: Options button: clear the favicon cache so icons are re-fetched on next open.

optionFaviconCacheClearConfirm.message: Clear the enriched icon cache? Icons will be re-fetched automatically on next open.
optionFaviconCacheClearConfirm.description: Confirmation shown before clearing the favicon cache.

optionFaviconCacheEmpty.description: Alert shown when the user clicks Clear icon cache and no cache keys exist.

optionFaviconCacheCleared.message: Icon cache cleared. Icons will be re-fetched on next open.
optionFaviconCacheCleared.description: Alert shown after clearing the favicon cache.

storageUsageIcon.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: bytes held by the favicon cache.

storageUsageBookmarks.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: bytes held by bookmark-derived data (dead-link scan, marks, visit stats).

storageUsageOther.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: bytes held by settings and any other data.

storageUsageFree.description: Storage usage bar legend segment: remaining space in chrome.storage.local.

storageUsageHint.message: Storage space used by bookmark scan/mark data, the icon cache and settings. Free space updates after clearing the icon cache.
storageUsageHint.description: Hint under the storage usage bar in the Icons group.

optionsDonate.description: Options page header button linking to the donation page.

optionsGithubLink.description: Options page header link to the GitHub profile/repository.

optionsHomepageLink.description: Options page header link to the plugin homepage.

optionsSince.message: Forked from Neat Bookmarks, maintained for $days$ days.
optionsSince.description: Subtitle under the options page title: days since the 1.0 fork from Neat Bookmarks.

optionsVersion.description: Tooltip for the version number shown at the top-right of the options page.

statsSortByCount.description: Stats view sort segment: order rows by visit count, highest first.

statsSortByRecent.description: Stats view sort segment: order rows by most recent visit first.

statsShowUnbookmarkedHint.message: Include pages from your history that are not saved as bookmarks.

statsEmpty.message: Statistics build up as you open bookmarks
statsEmpty.description: Empty state of the stats view when no visit data has been collected yet.

statsDisabledHint.message: Visit statistics are off — enable them in Options → Views
statsDisabledHint.description: Stats view empty state shown instead of data when the statsEnabled switch is off.

statsVisitCount.description: Aria label of the stats row count pill; $count$ is the visit count.

statsClearData.description: Button (stats view toolbar and options page) that wipes all collected visit statistics.

statsClearConfirm.message: Clear visit statistics for $count$ bookmarks? This cannot be undone.
statsClearConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog text before wiping visit statistics; $count$ is the number of bookmark entries.

statsHistoryBanner.message: Grant history access to seed visit statistics with your past visits.
statsHistoryBanner.description: Banner text on top of the recent view: invites granting the optional history permission so visit statistics can be seeded with past visits.

statsHistoryEnable.description: Link inside the recent view's history-permission banner: requests the optional history permission.

statsHistoryDismiss.description: aria-label of the dismiss button on the recent view's history-permission banner.

statsHistoryImported.description: Toast after the history import finished; $count$ is how many bookmarks received a seeded visit count.

paletteCmdThemeUsage.message: Usage: /theme followed by a theme name — auto, light, dark, ink or paper (a unique prefix works, e.g. /theme d).

paletteCustomDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the command "$1"? The change syncs to all your devices.

paletteCustomBroken.message: The folder of command "$1" no longer exists. Delete the command?

paletteCustomHint.message: Custom slash commands for the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K). They sync with your settings — 100 entries max.

paletteCustomTemplate.message: URL template — %s is replaced by the words after the command

paletteCustomErrSlash.message: Slash: 1–24 chars of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

paletteCustomErrAlias.message: Aliases: same rules as the slash (1–24 chars of lowercase letters, digits or hyphens).

paletteCustomErrTaken.message: That slash or alias is already taken.

paletteCustomErrUrl.message: Only http:// or https:// URLs are allowed.

paletteCustomErrTemplate.message: The template must contain exactly one %s.

paletteCustomErrLimit.message: Command limit reached (100) — delete one first.

settingsBackupHint.message: Export saves all settings (including sync preferences) to a JSON file. Import merges a backup back: settings in the file overwrite the current ones, everything else is kept.

settingsImportConfirm.message: Importing will overwrite every setting contained in the backup file (settings not in the file are kept) and reload this page. Continue?

settingsImportInvalid.message: Invalid settings file: not a vBookmarks settings backup.

settingsImportDone.message: Settings imported. The page will now reload.

settingsImportError.message: Some settings could not be written (storage quota or a transient error). The import did not complete — please try again.

statsHistoryGuide.message: Grant history access to list your recent visits here.

whatsNewFavicon.message: v$1$ is the favicon-enhanced release: site icons Chrome hasn't cached are now fetched automatically.

viewHiddenTabsHint.message: You're in the $view$ view. Press $back$ or use the command palette to return to the tree.
